verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a calendar product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The closest items are natural-language quick event entry (comm-15) and email-to-event conversion (comm-17), which are adjacent parsing features rather than task delegation to an assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
